provenance.identity_status: 4900 sn/楠楠 candidate; target 童声01 identity not established

assumptions: Input is the audited 4900 sn/楠楠 candidate; identity with target 童声01 is unconfirmed.
This is executable parameter reconstruction, not execution or bit-exact emulation of the original engine.
First-child truth polarity is an explicit parameter, not established from the original call path.
Unknown context questions remain unknown; diagnostic selection explores both branches and records its chosen path.
Frame shift defaults to 5 ms; original frame shift is not established.
Three 41-dimensional mean groups and variance groups are treated as static, delta, delta-delta observations.
Within each 41-vector, dimensions 0:16 constrain adjacent LSF spatial differences; dimensions 16:40 are the 24 LSFs. Spatial differences are not temporal deltas.
Temporal windows [1], [-.5,0,.5], [.25,-.5,.25] are observed backend constants; their use and endpoint replication here are assumptions.
Pitch triplets are interpreted as probability, natural-log-F0 mean, variance; the original execution path is unverified.
State-duration first five values are interpreted as relative state means; user duration rescales them. Original phone/state coupling and duration units are not reproduced.
LSF stabilization and filter bandwidth expansion are explicit reconstruction choices.
The last spectral scalar is exported but not used as amplitude because its gain semantics remain unknown.
The original opaque pulse table is not decoded or used; conventional excitation is substituted.
No original Chinese text frontend, lexicon, prosody model execution, coarticulation rules or full TTS is claimed.
